name: ground-band-split-line
description: From the title screen, enter the first world and let it settle, then poke a sentinel into $7BFC, the scanline the VBL handler at $051DCC loads into MFP Timer B ($FFFA21), and break on the next write while walking forward. Names the producer of the horizon scanline at which the Timer B handler at $052280 recolours hardware colour 8 from sky to ground (#281).
